title: Business Analyst
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: 30 Sept 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1747071

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**About EY**

At EY, our purpose is Building a better working world. It acts as our “North Star”, providing context and meaning for the work we do every day. We help digital pioneers address emerging risks, support governments and businesses through transformation, unlock value from data and technology, and strengthen trust in business and financial markets.

Through our integrated service lines of Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, and Tax, together with deep knowledge of sectors, we help clients capitalize on new opportunities, assess and manage risk, and deliver responsible growth. EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a global delivery network that brings together professionals across disciplines and locations to deliver technology, business, and operational solutions.

  

**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced and delivery-focused Supervising Associate - Business Analyst to join the ES - MENA Technology team. The role will serve as a bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, project managers, solution architects, developers, and quality assurance teams.

The successful candidate will lead requirement discovery, business process analysis, documentation, stakeholder alignment, solution validation, and requirements lifecycle management across technology initiatives. The role requires the flexibility to take ownership of, coordinate, or directly support quality assurance activities when project needs require it.

  

**Role Purpose**

Translate business needs into clear, traceable, testable, and implementation-ready specifications while helping delivery teams build solutions that meet stakeholder expectations, quality standards, and intended business outcomes.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

Business Analysis and Requirements Management

* Plan and lead requirements elicitation through workshops, interviews, discovery sessions, process walkthroughs, observation, document analysis, and other appropriate techniques.
* Analyze business problems, pain points, opportunities, and operating constraints, and translate them into well-defined business and solution requirements.
* Create and maintain business requirements documents, functional specifications, user stories, use cases, process flows, data requirements, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Create wireframes, mock-ups, process visualizations, and low-fidelity prototypes to facilitate requirement validation, stakeholder alignment, and solution design discussions.
* Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, feasible, unambiguous, prioritized, traceable, and testable.
* Manage the requirements lifecycle, including baselining, change control, impact assessment, stakeholder review, approval, and traceability through delivery and testing.
* Facilitate current-state and future-state analysis, gap assessments, root-cause analysis, and business process improvement.
* Translate complex business needs into actionable specifications for product, engineering, data, integration, and testing teams.

  

**Product and Solution Delivery**

* Contribute to business case development, investment justification, and strategic decision-making by evaluating business needs, solution options, costs, risks, and expected benefits.
* Partner with product owners and delivery leads to shape product backlogs, define priorities, clarify scope, and support roadmap and release planning.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, and retrospectives, as applicable.
* Collaborate with architects and developers to clarify requirements, evaluate solution options, resolve requirement gaps, and support informed trade-off decisions.
* Support change readiness, release readiness, deployment planning, and post-implementation validation.
* Promote AI-assisted requirements engineering, structured specification practices, reusable templates, and consistent analysis standards, with appropriate human review and validation.

  

**Quality Assurance and Testing**

* Define measurable acceptance criteria and confirm that functional and non-functional requirements are testable.
* Develop, review, or refine test scenarios, test cases, test data needs, and expected results based on approved requirements.
* Participate in or coordinate system integration testing, regression testing, business validation, and user acceptance testing.
* Validate test coverage against requirements and maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, and defects.
* Support defect triage, severity and priority discussions, root-cause analysis, retesting, and closure validation.
* When required, perform hands-on functional testing and assume QA coordination responsibilities to support delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with QA and engineering teams on test automation opportunities, quality controls, and continuous improvement of testing practices.

  

**Stakeholder Management and Leadership**

* Build effective working relationships with business and technology stakeholders across MENA, GDS, and global teams.
* Facilitate decisions, manage competing priorities, and communicate requirement impacts, dependencies, risks, and unresolved questions clearly.
* Present analysis, recommendations, process models, and requirement artifacts to senior stakeholders in a concise and business-focused manner.
* Provide guidance, peer review, and mentoring to junior business analysts and contribute to capability-building initiatives.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, accountability, and a quality-first approach throughout the delivery lifecycle.

  

**Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute reusable requirement assets, user story patterns, checklists, process models, test artifacts, and lessons learned to shared repositories.
* Identify opportunities to improve business analysis, requirements governance, quality assurance, and delivery practices.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, AI-enabled delivery methods, business analysis practices, and relevant industry trends.

  

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-support skills.
* Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing capabilities.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt messages for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, structured documentation skills, and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and coordinate multiple priorities with minimal supervision.
* Business process analysis and modelling capability, with a practical understanding of controls, exceptions, dependencies, and data flows.
* Learning agility, adaptability, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to balance business value, user experience, delivery constraints, risk, and technical feasibility.

  

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 7-12 years of industry experience, including at least 5 years of relevant domain experience in business analysis, product analysis, functional consulting, product ownership, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, specification, validation, prioritization, traceability, and change management.
* Hands-on experience creating business requirements documents, functional specifications, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, process flows, data requirements, and traceability matrices.
* Experience working across the software development lifecycle and within Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* Practical knowledge of software testing lifecycle activities, including functional testing, system integration testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing, defect management, and test traceability.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops and working with cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of lifecycle and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability and willingness to take up QA coordination and hands-on functional testing responsibilities when required.

  

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* IIBA CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, PSPO, CSPO, ISTQB, or a relevant equivalent certification.
* Experience supporting enterprise application delivery, digital transformation, shared services, consulting, finance, tax, risk, HR, or other business domains.
* Exposure to AI-assisted requirements analysis, specification-driven delivery, low-code platforms, Power Platform, Power BI, or Copilot-enabled solutions.
* Experience with test automation concepts, QA governance, business process improvement, or change management.

  

**What We Look For**

We look for a proactive and outcome-oriented professional who combines strong business analysis capability with a quality-first mindset. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between stakeholder engagement, process analysis, requirements definition, user story development, solution clarification, test planning, hands-on functional validation, and delivery coordination. The individual should be able to lead through influence, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain high standards of traceability, governance, and stakeholder communication.

  

**Role Success Indicators**

* Requirements are clear, approved, traceable, implementation-ready, and supported by measurable acceptance criteria.
* Stakeholders have timely visibility of scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, and open questions.
* Delivery and QA teams receive sufficient clarification and testable specifications to minimize avoidable rework.
* Test coverage aligns with approved requirements, and defects are managed through effective triage and validation.
* Reusable analysis and quality practices improve consistency across the MENA Technology delivery portfolio.

  

**Working Style**

The role requires flexibility to operate across concurrent initiatives, collaborate across time zones, and adjust the balance between business analysis and QA responsibilities according to delivery priorities. The individual is expected to exercise sound judgment, protect business intent, and actively support successful outcomes from discovery through implementation and validation.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Analyst 1
description:
**Job Description: AMOS Business Analyst**

**Location: Kochi**

**Experience: 8-10 years**

Department: Global Technology & Enterprise Services (GTES) Function: AMOS Platform / Billing & Financial Systems Reports to: Program Manager / Director, Platform Engineering Location: [Insert location — remote/hybrid/onsite] Employment Type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Business Analyst to support the AMOS (billing and invoicing) platform as part of our ongoing migration from legacy systems (GMAX/AGM) to AMOS across multiple international markets. This role sits at the intersection of business requirements, financial/billing logic, and technical delivery — translating market-specific billing, tax, and card-processing rules into clear specifications that development and QA teams can build and test against.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across GDS platforms (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo), card/payment feeds, invoicing and tax compliance requirements (e.g., VAT, TADC), and cross-functional coordination with global stakeholders, vendors, and clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

Requirements & Market Analysis

Analyze market-specific billing, card feed, and invoicing requirements across multiple countries and translate them into clear, testable specifications.

Maintain and update market analysis trackers (status, complexity, dependencies) and report progress to stakeholders and leadership.

Identify and document dependencies on external systems and partners (GDS providers, rail providers, card networks, tax engines).

Card Feed & MI Mapping

Validate and define MI (Management Information) reference field mappings between source systems (GMAX/AGM) and AMOS, ensuring alignment with card network specifications (e.g., Amex TADC).

Investigate and resolve data mapping discrepancies (e.g., field-length constraints, swapped or mismatched reference fields) in coordination with technical and card-network teams.

Migration & Cutover Support

Support pilot and production cutover planning — reviewing DK/account lists, reporting IDs, transaction volumes, and product configurations ahead of go-live.

Coordinate cutover readiness across GDS-managed and partner-managed feeds (e.g., Amadeus-managed vs. non-Amadeus/partner-managed sales units).

Track and report on go/no-go criteria, open defects, and outstanding dependencies before each cutover.

Dispute & Exception Analysis

Analyze dispute and exception data (e.g., authorization failures, card/FOP mismatches, VAT/tax validation errors, write-offs) to identify root causes and quantify financial exposure.

Prepare status updates and recommendations for leadership, distinguishing recoverable balances from permanent losses and proposing remediation priorities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, QA, and external vendors/partners (e.g., GDS providers, card networks, outsourced development vendors) to drive issues to resolution.

Manage and track defects, user stories, and change requests through JIRA, ensuring clear ownership and timely closure.

Communicate clearly and concisely with senior/executive stakeholders, tailoring technical detail to the audience.

Documentation & Reporting

Produce clear business requirement documents, process flow diagrams, and status reports.

Maintain accurate, up-to-date tracking of feature/defect status, complexity, and market coverage.

**Required Qualifications**

4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in financial systems, billing/invoicing platforms, or travel/payments technology.

Strong understanding of billing, invoicing, and card-payment processing concepts (form of payment, tokenization/masking, VAT/tax rules, reconciliation).

Experience working with or analyzing GDS platforms (Amadeus, Sabre, or Galileo) is highly desirable.

Proficiency in Excel/spreadsheet-based analysis (pivot tables, data reconciliation, large dataset analysis).

Experience with JIRA or similar issue-tracking tools for requirements and defect management.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex technical/financial issues for senior leadership.

Experience coordinating across distributed, global teams and time zones.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to data accuracy and detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Direct experience with AMOS, AGM, GMAX, Suntec, or NFP platforms (or equivalent travel/expense billing systems).

Experience with card network reporting/compliance specifications (e.g., Amex TADC).

Familiarity with rail and hotel billback processes, LinkOnline/rail data feeds, or similar travel-industry data integrations.

Experience managing or coordinating with outsourced development vendors.

Exposure to European VAT/tax compliance requirements (e.g., Spain, Nordics, DACH markets).

**Soft Skills**

Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity through structured analysis.

Confident communicating status, risk, and financial exposure to senior/executive stakeholders.

Collaborative and proactive in resolving cross-team dependencies.

Note: This description reflects the scope of AMOS-related business analyst work as commonly practiced (market/billing analysis, card feed mapping, migration cutover support, dispute/exception analysis, and cross-functional coordination). Please adjust seniority level, compensation grade, location, and specific tooling requirements to match your organization's HR templates and the exact scope of the open role.

Pay: ₹1,700,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Python Engineer (AI/ML & Video Analytics)
description:
Senior Python Engineer (AI/ML \& Video Analytics), Returnship Welcome

**Location:** Infopark, Kochi, Kerala  
**Experience:** 6\+ years in Python  
**Employment type:** Full\-time

About the role

We're building intelligent systems that turn video into decisions: detecting events, tracking activity, and generating real\-time insights. We're looking for an experienced Python engineer who is excited by AI/ML and computer vision and wants to do meaningful work again after a career break. Your years of experience matter more to us than a continuous CV. If you've stepped away and are ready to return, this role is designed with you in mind.

What you'll do

* Design and build Python services and pipelines for video ingestion, processing, and analysis
* Develop, fine\-tune, and deploy computer vision models
* Turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable production systems
* Build APIs (FastAPI/Django/Flask) that deliver model outputs to dashboards and applications

What we're looking for

**Must have**

* 6\+ years of professional Python experience, including production backend work
* Hands\-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
* Working knowledge of OpenCV and video processing (FFmpeg, GStreamer, or similar)
* Solid grounding in ML fundamentals and model evaluation
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, Git, and Docker
* Genuine curiosity for AI/ML and video analytics, shown through work, projects, or self\-learning

**Good to have**

* Experience with YOLO, DeepStream, ONNX, or TensorRT
* Cloud deployment on AWS, Azure, or GCP; Kubernetes; CI/CD
* MLOps tooling such as MLflow or model monitoring
* Streaming and messaging systems (Kafka, RTSP pipelines)
* Recent upskilling through courses, open\-source, or personal projects

Returnship support

* A structured onboarding and skills\-refresh period for the first \[4\-6] weeks
* A mentor from the senior engineering team
* A supportive culture where a career break is a chapter, not a gap

Why join us

* Work on real AI/ML and video analytics problems, not maintenance\-only tasks
* A collaborative team in Infopark, Kochi's tech hub
* Competitive compensation

How to apply

If interested, kindly share me your updated resume to prasanth@stream\-perfect.com
